verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a built-in on-call scheduling capability. It offers standard rotation schedules that pre-fill the on-call calendar, web or Google Calendar schedule management, one-click overrides and cover requests, and a complex-schedules guide that builds separate EU, US West and Asia/Pacific schedules for 24/7 follow-the-sun coverage. However, multi-layer schedules and round-robin coverage are not shown in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit schedule layers, round-robin coverage, detail on rotation configuration options, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build on-call schedules with rotations, layers, time zones, and round-robin coverage that match how my teams actually work

citations.quote: Leverage one of our standard rotation schedules to instantly pre-fill your on-call calendar.
First, create three schedules for EU, US West, and Asia/Pacific time zones to ensure 24/7 global coverage.
Manage on-call schedules from our built-in web interface or keep them in a shared Google calendar.
Create overrides with a single click
